$description: Roof-edition reskin: same 26 tasks, same codes, same data layout — the heist now plays out on the helipad-and-rooftop track, with helicopter wind ambient and Karl-and-Theo rooftop chatter swapped in for the lobby intercepts.

ambient.label: Roof-wind + helicopter
ambient.description: Higher-frequency wind noise + a periodic distant helicopter drone on the ambient bus. The default Christmas-bell overlay is suppressed.

story_beats.act_1_open: It's Christmas Eve, 1988. The helicopter has just touched down on Nakatomi Plaza's roof. Hans Gruber's team is staging from the helipad — every move tonight starts with the rotor wash overhead.
story_beats.act_5_intro: The seventh seal is the last barrier between you and the helicopter. The C4 charges on the roof have a 12-minute fuse, and Hans wants to be in the air before the FBI arrives.

intercepts.lobby_alarm_replacement: Theo on roof comms: "Wind's picking up — keep the rotor warm. We move when the seventh seal opens."

endings.default_intro_override: The seventh seal cracks. Wind howls past the open helipad door. "Welcome to the rooftop, pal."
